extDescription.message: Local check-in assistant, paused by default. Identity checks, single-attempt submission, stop on uncertainty and manual handoff.

popupNote.message: Connect your account read-only first. Automation requires explicit opt-in; verification or unknown results pause it. Success is not guaranteed.

loginRequired.message: Please log in to glados.cloud first

notifyNetMessage.message: Failed to read points history; will retry at the next slot

notifyFailFallback.message: Will retry at the next slot

notifyLoginTitle.message: Please log in to GLaDOS first

notifyLoginMessage.message: This extension uses your browser session. Please log in to glados.cloud first.

timeoutNoButton.message: Timed out: Check in button not found

bgHint.message: Schedules require the browser process and system to run. The "$TOGGLE$" setting at $URL$ does not guarantee operation after closing windows; test your browser.
bgHint.description: Popup background-running hint with settings URL and toggle name

toggle.example: Continue running background apps when Google Chrome is closed

toggleNameChrome.message: Continue running background apps when Google Chrome is closed

toggleNameEdge.message: Continue running background extensions and apps when Microsoft Edge is closed

btnCopySettings.description: Copy chrome:// or edge:// settings URL

notifyBgTitle.description: First-install reminder title for the background toggle

notifyBgMessage.message: To keep auto check-in after closing windows, turn on “Continue running background apps when the browser is closed” in system settings. Clicking the window X is fine; Exit from the tray stops the extension.
notifyBgMessage.description: First-install reminder body for the background toggle

reviewTask.message: I reviewed it; clear task block

consentEnable.message: Allow a single attempt at 09:30 / 12:30 / 20:30 Beijing time? The browser must run, pages may open and verification may need you. Unknown results pause automation; no redemption.

consentRun.message: Attempt one check-in? This may change account points; no automatic redemption.

consentReview.message: First verify your status on the official site. Clearing the block does not submit and keeps automation paused. A later attempt may repeat a submission. Continue?

consentForget.message: Pause and clear extension records? This does not log out of the official site or close open pages.

errorSafe.message: Operation not completed. Check the account or task state; no success was reported.

OBSERVED.message: Check-in record observed (not attributed to this attempt)

ledgerNote.message: At most the first 10 returned records are checked. Compensation, refunds and exchanges are not treated as check-ins.
